title: Rationally Enriched Chebyshev Trunk Bases for DeepONet Surrogates of High P\'eclet Entrance Transport
abstract: arXiv:2608.19658v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This study demonstrates a rationally enriched Chebyshev (REC) trunk for deep operator network (DeepONet) surrogate models of singularly perturbed and high-P\'eclet transport problems whose solution profiles are characterized by thin localized boundary or wall layers. The REC trunk combines Chebyshev polynomial dictionary elements with rational dictionary elements constructed using the adaptive Antoulas-Anderson (AAA) algorithm. Over five independent training runs, the resulting REC-trunk DeepONet is evaluated against a vanilla DeepONet and a Chebyshev-trunk DeepONet whose prescribed dictionary consists only of Chebyshev polynomials across three problems whose singular perturbation parameters are diffusion-to-advection ratios: a singularly perturbed scalar boundary-value problem (BVP), the thermal entrance problem with a prescribed wall temperature, and the concentration entrance problem with an absorbing wall. translated_title: 高佩克莱数入口输运的DeepONet代理模型中理性增强切比雪夫主干基
translated_abstract: 摘要：本研究展示了一种理性增强切比雪夫（REC）主干，用于奇异摄动和高佩克莱数输运问题的深度算子网络（DeepONet）代理模型，其解特征为薄局部边界或壁层。REC主干结合了切比雪夫多项式字典元素和使用自适应Antoulas-Anderson（AAA）算法构建的有理字典元素。在五次独立训练运行中，将生成的REC主干DeepONet与普通DeepONet和仅由切比雪夫多项式组成的切比雪夫主干DeepONet进行了评估，涉及三个奇异摄动参数为扩散-对流比的问题：奇异摄动标量边界值问题（BVP）、指定壁温的热入口问题以及吸收壁的浓度入口问题。在保留的测试集上，结果显示...
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合切比雪夫多项式与AAA算法有理元素的理性增强切比雪夫主干，显著提升了DeepONet在高佩克莱数输运问题中薄边界层解的代理建模精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a rationally enriched Chebyshev trunk combining Chebyshev polynomials with AAA-based rational elements, significantly improving DeepONet surrogate accuracy for thin boundary layer solutions in high-Péclet transport problems.
